product_metadata.title: 16 x 72 Inch Merry Christmas Table Runner, Seasonal Winter Xmas Holiday Kitchen Dining Table Decoration for Indoor Outdoor - Suitable for 2-4 People
features: 🎄【High-Quality Material】- 16 x 72 inch Christmas table runner. The material is 100% polyester, easy care and machine washable.(12.3 ounces)

🎄【Suitable Table Size】- The size of this Christmas table runner is 16 x 72 inches, suitable for a table for 2-4 people, bringing you a pleasant dining experience. Suitable for dining tables, coffee tables, cabinets, TV stations, bedside tables, sideboards, etc. It can be used alone or combined with tablecloths, placemats or napkins to add color and interest.

🎄【Nice-Looking Table Runner】- This christmas table runner has tassels on both ends, beautifully printed Santa Claus and Christmas tree pattern, easy to clean and does not fade, the back is cotton texture, it is not easy to slip off on any material table. You will discover how amazing this handicraft is!
🎄【Occasion】- Perfect home decoration table runner, it is best for christmas, everyday use, holiday birthday party, lumberjack party, wedding, baby shower and any other occasion.
🎄【Easy to Clean】- The color will not fade after washing. It is best to wash by hand. It can be gently machine-washed, lie flat and dry, ironed at low temperature, and cannot be bleached.
